name: orc_expander_pump_empirical_maps
title: ORC expander and pump empirical maps (function library)
summary: Eleven ThermoCycle performance-map functions for ORC machines — isentropic efficiency and filling factor of hermetic-scroll, open-drive and single-screw expanders, test-rig pump mass-flow and efficiency curves, SQ-thesis pump efficiency and rig line pressure drops — with a small closed R245fa ORC demo that couples the hermetic-scroll map to a pump curve.

origin.course: ThermoCycle Modelica library, ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory; fits of the ULiège ORC test rigs

verification.reference: independent Python re-evaluation of the eleven polynomials written from the .mo sources (log = natural logarithm in Modelica) with CoolProp 8.0.0 states for the ORC demo, script kept in the throw-away work folder and deleted; energy-balance closure
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 62 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); maximum relative difference 9.74e-11 (eta_th) excluding err_bal, which is 0 by construction in Python and 5.5e-12 W in CoolSolve; 17 CoolSolve-only variables are the demo inputs and the constants of the check points. ThermoCycle stores no reference results, so no published value of the fits was available.

history.action: added (translation of the ThermoCycle expander and pump maps, card C-91)
